card.name: Words inside institution and author names
card.fires_on: Words inside names of organisations, agencies or people in general web prose, such as 'by' before an agency, or a part of a name like Centre, Technology, Deep. It often comes just before the next part of the name or a collaborating body.

modes.label: By before an agency
modes.description: The word 'by' linking a work to the organisation that prepared or funded it.
modes.example: A Study Prepared<< by>> The Department of Defense.

modes.label: Inside organisation names
modes.description: A word within a institute, centre or government body name.
modes.example: A recent report by the Massachusetts Institute of<< Technology>> on coal’s future

modes.label: Partway through a proper name
modes.description: A piece of a surname or place name that is not yet complete.
modes.example: proved too much for Wool<<f>>'s sensitive nature

card.writes: No clear output effect, though it slightly suppresses 'partner' words and so pushes away from partnership wording.
card.plain: It lights up inside the names of institutions and people, especially after 'prepared by' or 'supported by'.
